Relief shown pictorially. Depths shown by soundings. Title from plate 17. Originally published as 1 map on 20 sheets. LC copy bound. Index map bound-in. Sheet of paper (25 x 19 cm.) listing the numbered plates mounted on preliminary leaf. On title cartouche (plate 17): C. Lempriere inv. & del., B. Baron, sculp. Includes notes, dedication, 4 views, and 17 harbor insets. Margins trimmed on index map. Conserved July 15, 1985. Phillips. Maps of America, p. 569 Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Conserved; 04-85-021.1 1985 Library of Congress Conservation Division.
